name: Beer-lahai-roi
line: Beer-lahai-roi is a well in the wilderness south-west of Beersheba, where the Lord met Hagar and where Isaac later lived.

moments.title: Isaac Near the Well
moments.text: Isaac had just returned from Beer-lahai-roi, since he was living in the Negev. Then he met Rebekah, took her as his wife, and loved her.

moments.title: God Blesses Isaac
moments.text: After Abraham died, God blessed his son Isaac, who lived near Beer-lahai-roi.
